# Aegis Health AI — Technical Product & Architecture Overview (llms.txt)

> Clinical-Grade Longitudinal Medical Intelligence & Diagnostic Biomarker Platform built on Google Cloud, Vertex AI, Gemini 3.8 Flash (`gemini-3.8-flash`), and Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`).

## 1. Executive Summary
Aegis Health AI (`https://aegishealthai.co.in`) is an independent, AI-native healthcare technology platform engineered in India to solve medical record fragmentation. It ingests unstructured multi-page pathology PDFs, diagnostic lab reports (Thyrocare, Dr. Lal PathLabs, Metropolis, SRL/Agilus, Apollo), and handwritten clinical prescriptions, extracting normalized quantitative biomarkers, calculating longitudinal multi-year trend velocity, applying ICMR / South Asian cardiometabolic stratification, and generating structured SBAR (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) physician handoff briefs with downloadable OPD PDFs and HL7 FHIR R4 bundles.

## 2. Public Clinical Sandbox & Demonstration (Open Evaluation Mode)
Aegis Health AI provides an interactive, zero-barrier demonstration workspace so users, clinicians, and platform reviewers can evaluate the operational product immediately without requiring registration:

1. **Direct Public Clinical Workspace (`/dashboard` or `/demo`)**:
   - Navigate directly to `https://aegishealthai.co.in/dashboard` or `https://aegishealthai.co.in/demo`.
   - Loads instantly in an interactive **Guest Demonstration Mode** with pre-populated longitudinal patient telemetry (`Aarav Sharma, 38M`) across multiple Indian pathology panels (Metropolis, Thyrocare, Apollo).
   - **Automated SBAR Physician Briefs (`#sbar`)**: Fully interactive Situation, Background, Assessment, and Recommendation brief, accompanied by an OPD Consultation Checklist, an **ICMR / South Asian vs. Western Reference Range Stratification Table**, and 1-click **Download PDF** & **HL7 FHIR R4 Bundle** exports.
   - **Interactive 4-Stage Extraction Pipeline Demo (`#upload` / Ingest Tab)**: Demonstrates the multi-stage document processing pipeline with per-biomarker confidence flags, SI-to-conventional unit conversions (`59.9 nmol/L → 24.0 ng/mL`), and ICMR cardiometabolic risk stratification in an isolated client-side walkthrough.
   - **Multi-Patient Indian Family Hub (`#family`)**: Interface for managing multi-generational Indian household profiles (Self, Parents, Children under DPDP compliance).
2. **Interactive 4-Stage Pipeline Sandbox on Homepage (`/`)**:
   - Accessible directly on `https://aegishealthai.co.in/#interactive-sandbox`.

## 3. Indian Diagnostic Lab Extraction Benchmark (N = 120 De-Identified Reports)
Internal validation benchmark evaluating schema-constrained Gemini 3.8 Flash + Gemini 4 Argon escalation (for complex multi-page & handwritten reports) on analyte normalization, numeric extraction, SI-to-conventional unit conversion, and ICMR flag accuracy:
- **Thyrocare Technologies (Aarogyam PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.6%` | Recall `99.3%` | **F1 = `99.4%`** (Handles dense multi-column tables, CLIA/Photometry tags, nmol/L → ng/mL Vitamin D conversion)
- **Dr. Lal PathLabs (NABL Multi-Page PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.5%` | Recall `99.1%` | **F1 = `99.3%`** (Handles nested age/trimester brackets, footnote commentary stripping, DLC % vs absolute count)
- **Metropolis Healthcare (Clinical Panels, N=25)**: Precision `99.7%` | Recall `99.4%` | **F1 = `99.5%`** (Handles historical prior-value columns, asterisk abnormal flags, ICMR lipid risk tiers)
- **SRL Diagnostics / Agilus & Apollo (N=20)**: Precision `99.3%` | Recall `98.9%` | **F1 = `99.1%`** (Handles scanned hospital letterheads, SGPT/ALT & SGOT/AST synonym harmonization)
- **Smartphone Camera Photos + Handwritten OPD Rx (N=15)**: Precision `96.2%` | Recall `93.8%` | **F1 = `95.0%`** (Tokens `<90%` OCR confidence are automatically flagged with an amber warning badge for user confirmation)

## 5. Google Cloud & AI Architecture
- **AI / ML Models**: Dual-tier Google Gemini routing via `@google/genai` SDK:
  - **Gemini 3.8 Flash (`gemini-3.8-flash`)**: High-speed multimodal document OCR, schema-constrained JSON biomarker parsing, and real-time specialist chat.
  - **Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`)**: 1M-token deep reasoning model automatically invoked for complex multi-page diagnostic PDFs, low-confidence/handwritten OPD prescriptions (`<85%` initial OCR confidence), 10-specialist clinical reasoning, hereditary risk analysis, and SBAR physician handover synthesis.
- **Serverless Compute**: Cloudflare Workers edge AI routing (`aegishealthai-edge`) and Firebase Cloud Functions Gen 2 (Node.js 22 on Cloud Run) acting as zero-trust API proxies with Secret Manager integration, per-UID rate-limiting, and PII scrubbing before inference.
- **Database & Storage**: Cloud Firestore with strict per-user (`users/{userId}/...`) security rules, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and automated cascading account purge (`onUserDeleted`).
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, hosted on Firebase Hosting with route-specific pre-rendered HTML shells and strict security headers (`Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`).
